profile.headline: Web Developer at ClearCaptions, LLC
profile.summary: Experienced Digital Marketing Specialist with a demonstrated history of working with Nonprofit Organizations. Skilled in Analytical Skills, Databases, International Relations, HTML, and Leadership. Strong marketing professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in International Studies - Global Security from University of Wisconsin-Madison.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
• Research and evaluate client's marketing goals, target audience, and local competition to provide custom tailored website designs.
• Ensure client-provided content is search engine optimized by utilizing SEO best practices and semantic HTML.
• Provide content updates, SEO, analytics reporting, and other maintenance functions following completion of projects.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
• Lead QA Testing Automation using tools like Testim, Playwright, and visual regression, ensuring WCAG compliance and Lighthouse score optimization.
• Manage data integrations and analytics, including Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, and creating dashboards to standardize best practices.
• Oversee CI/CD processes with GitHub Actions and server/environment management.
• Develop and maintain backend solutions in WordPress, leveraging Gutenberg, PHP, and MySQL.
• Build dynamic frontend interfaces with API integrations (e.g., Klaviyo, Monday.com, Sweed, WordPress).
• Design Klaviyo workflows and structure data for efficient workflows.
• Administer WordPress, including data imports, manual entries, and page building

positions.title: Front-end Web Developer
positions.description:
• Develop custom WordPress themes and plugins to meet client specifications
• Collaborate with designers and project managers to ensure seamless integration of front end and back end code
• Implement best practices in WordPress development to ensure scalability, security, and maintainability of codebase
• Optimize website performance through caching, minification, and other techniques
• Perform regular updates and maintenance tasks to ensure smooth operation of websites
• Install, configure, and highly customize WooCommerce installations
• Optimize WordPress websites for SEO by implementing best practices for on-page optimization, including keyword research, meta tags, and content optimization
• Work with SEO specialists to implement SEO strategies for clients to improve search engine rankings and drive organic traffic

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
* Systems management
* Data backup and recovery
* Data storage, warehouse, and management
* Network monitoring, management, and security

positions.title: Marketing and Social Media Specialist VISTA
positions.description:
• Oversee the planning, copywriting, execution and reporting of social media strategies.
• Measure and report the performance of social media campaigns, assess against goals, and provide recommendations to improve performance.
• Research, implement, and systematize into a user guide the best practices for non-profit social media marketing.

company.name: Habitat for Humanity of Waukesha County

positions.title: Business Development and Open Source Analyst
positions.description:
Business Development
• Conducted market research to identify and called on C-level leadership at mid to large market US companies in all industries with potential for parent company in the UAE to invest in or partner with.
• Scheduled and coordinated initial and follow up meetings between identified and interested companies and Head of US Operations in an attempt to secure partnership.
• Created Business Plans that outlined partnership opportunity as follow up to initial meetings.

Open Source Analyst
• Actively monitored, investigated, and documented violent extremism in Libya.	    
• Co-created, updated, and edited LIAS’s “Terrorism in Libya” weekly report, as featured in Bloomberg and Al-Monitor.               
• Managed data capturing, processing, and analysis of OSINT.
• Created and disseminated four internally and externally circulated daily news reports. 
• Presented key findings to senior leadership.

positions.title: Information Architect
positions.description:
• Researched and submitted reports on violations of UNSCR 1973 to UN Panel of Experts.
• Actively monitored, investigated, and documented violent extremism in Libya.
• Managed data capturing, processing, and analysis of OSINT.
• Led the development of a dynamic database of Libyan events and media.

volunteerExperiences.description: I assisted in taking in, weighing and sorting donations. I also assisted in preparing some of the food before it was sent to distribution.
